evidence.title: MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks

summary: Researchers introduce MobilePA-Bench, a benchmark designed to test the capabilities of mobile planner agents in handling complex, real-world scenarios. The tool aims to advance the development of AI systems for practical, dynamic environments.
title: New Benchmark MobilePA-Bench Evaluates AI Planner Agents on Real-World Tasks
